chiru: Khan makha mun kha mak a ama kho tieng rushe joi, khan akhaichawi hai na ama kha rujui uh.
english: Then He went out from there and came to His own country, and His disciples followed Him.

chiru: Khan Sabbath nikho hawng nih phakhan, synagogue ah miruchuh ruput. Rangai mi tampui kha shinrudawng pe ua amani na ruti uh, 'Hi miring hi na hihaihi khoshekawt a imuk maw nih? Khan ama dieng a ipek shingna hai le ama khuttak le ranakniei chon hai ithaw hi imaw nih?'
english: And when the Sabbath had come, He began to teach in the synagogue. And many hearing Him were astonished, saying, Where did this Man get these things? And what wisdom is this which is given to Him, that such mighty works are performed by His hands!

chiru: Aneh-ashah apa hai kha bawp rahnga runih uh.
english: Now those who had eaten the loaves were about five thousand men.

chiru: for they all saw Him and were troubled. But immediately He talked with them and said to them, Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid.
english: Ajarla amani kholok na ama kha muk u `le, rurawthawk uh. Relentak a amani le riebieh a ruriei, 'Nang mulung mangar u roh! Kiei kanih keng; chih u naw roh.'

chiru: Khan ama lutnalutna: kho ah nit a, khopui ah nit a, inleloi mun ah nita`awm, ana hai kha rievieithawna mun a rutet uh. Ama pon rieshiei mawrtaka kha nita`awm mishitna rang, ama dieng runik uh. Khan ponmawr ashih miring rikip kha irumadam inih.
english: Wherever He entered, into villages, cities, or the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged Him that they might just touch the hem of His garment. And as many as touched Him were made well.
